title: myRNASeqPipeline samplesheet
description: Experiment manifest. Declared ONCE and reused by every stage, so experimental design is never re-entered -- that is where samples get mismatched. Unreserved columns are carried verbatim into the meta map and land in adata.obs.

sample.errorMessage: sample is required and cannot contain spaces

srr.help_text: stage counts: SRA accession. Alternative to fastq_1/fastq_2.

counts.help_text: stage counts with --step counts: the quantifier's output directory.

chemistry.help_text: Optional override. Omit to auto-detect from R1 length; a declaration contradicting the read length is a hard error.

condition.help_text: Biological group. Consumed by Part 5 (DE). NEVER use as batch_key.

batch.help_text: TECHNICAL grouping (chip, run, prep day). Defaults to sample. Consumed by integration in stage qc.

anyOf.description: stage qc locates <counts_dir>/<sample>.h5ad by convention, so no file column is needed
